INVENTORY.description: Record current refs/route receipts, authored owners and exact evidence manifest; old audit is historical.

EDITORIAL.description: Named source/editorial/rights review of exact public claims and useful reader situations; no inferred endorsement.

QUERY-INTENT.description: After analytics delivery, review evidence-backed reader/problem/query/page map, overlap, priority and unknown demand; no Terra execution inferred.

P2-CONTENT.description: P2 actual Home/Research/Writing/Talks candidate satisfies reader paths and preserves catalog, URLs, state and Credits; current invariant tests do not prove future usefulness.

BRIEFS.description: P2 useful delivery and agent-control briefs with artifacts/examples, evidence/rights, links and #11/#2/#5 overlap/handoff; no publication.

STYLE-REVIEW.description: Independent applicable CS01-CS10 architecture/readability/behavior review; bounded guard proves only its enforced subset.

QUALITY.description: Four distinct completed requirements, code, white-box and exploratory inspections on exact candidate, with test allocation and correction re-review.

SURFACES.description: Actual applicable desktop/mobile/theme/keyboard/touch/motion/no-JS/print observations; retain separate physical-device/human limits.

RELEASES.description: Separate P1 and P2 staging/admission, protected merge, identical-tree production candidate, authorizations, live smoke and recovery identities; P1 does not close the issue.

MEASUREMENT.description: Reproducible Cloudflare/GSC baseline and equal-window learning method; raw/filtered/source denominators and release cutovers separate; future ranks/volume not a closure oracle.

HUMAN-READER.description: P2 uncoached actual first-time reader including enterprise/IT-services perspective explains author, two directions, relevant work/contact; resolve confusion on corrected source.

BASELINE.description: Exact fixed-window aggregate RUM and separate GSC receipts with sampling/freshness/returned coverage and observed emitter inventory; no history attribution from browser alone.

ISOLATION-DECISION.description: Review traced production contexts and selected minimal isolation boundary/residual gaps before telemetry edits; no blanket headless/reader suppression.

ISOLATION-BEHAVIOR.description: New mechanism remains pending: actual contrast/leak/failure cases must prove identified QA suppression and ordinary collection; existing alias tests alone cannot prove it.

BROWSER.description: Run applicable maintained vendor-stub/current candidate browser journeys; fixture success is not production ingestion.

LIVE.description: After P1 release observe actual production canonical/alias/history/filter/reload/SDK and deliberate bounded provider receipt; revalidate applicable P2 behavior separately.

REPORT.description: Operator reproduces actual read-only interval/page/referrer reporting with raw/non-headless/visits/GSC separate and unavailable fields explicit.

COMPARISON.description: Retain comparable before/after elapsed windows and both release cutovers; sampling/cohort breaks prevent causal or human/lead claims.

ARTICLE-HANDOFF.description: Manifest-declared fixture/report readiness; real future article receipt remains #5 AC08/AC17 with #2, organic #8, conversions #104; no draft publication.

HISTORY.description: Preserve #158/#102 source-to-local mapping and accepted dated #102/AC03 tick without declaring a new clean baseline; review exact archived provenance.

VITALS-COST.description: Actual dimensions and separate per-vital samples, absent-INP limits, hosted SDK transfer/CPU cost under existing budgets and corrected runbook; no loopback substitute.
